simulator.name: terrain-fno
simulator.label: FNO on the terrain profile
simulator.notes: Distance and azimuth backbone; the terrain term is a 1-D FNO over the 128-point path profile, on a unit-length axis so path length cannot leak in.

availability.name: availability
availability.label: Availability
availability.blurb: the cell has a serving cell at all, this fraction of the time

rsrp.name: rsrp

sinr_db.label: Link quality (SINR)
